    GRT price performance

    Over the past year, The Graph has fallen 65.4%. Its daily closes ranged from $0.0132 (August 18, 2026) to $0.0699 (November 7, 2025) over the last 52 weeks. On November 3, 2026 it closed at $0.0196, 71.9% below that high, with 30-day annualized volatility of 68%. Its best full month was Sep 2026 (+78.51%) and its worst was Dec 2025 (-32.73%). Over the last 90 days its daily moves had a correlation of 0.57 with Bitcoin's (loosely tied; 1 would mean moving in lockstep). Its largest fall between daily closes within the year was 81.2%, from November 7, 2025 to August 18, 2026. Over one year it ranked 8th of the 8 AI coins tracked here with a full year of data.

    About The Graph

    The Graph is a decentralized protocol for indexing and querying blockchain data. GRT is staked by indexers and used to pay for queries.

    Where this GRT price comes from

    The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (GRT-USD), Binance (GRT/USDT) and Kraken (GRT/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 10.51B GRT (supply last updated November 3, 2026). Prices on different exchanges can differ slightly; the table above shows each one and the spread between them.
